verdict.rationale: incident.io documents AI postmortem drafting: it generates first drafts, gives inline review suggestions, and redrafts sections, which supports a human-review workflow. Related features auto-generate a timeline from key events and use AI to draft follow-up actions from incident activity. However, the docs never say the AI postmortem draft itself contains the timeline, contributing factors, and follow-ups. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the AI draft includes timeline, contributing-factor analysis, and follow-ups; independent or hands-on corroboration of draft quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI drafts the postmortem from the incident record — timeline, contributing factors, follow-ups — ready for human review

citations.quote: Generate first drafts, get inline review suggestions, and redraft sections with AI.
We generate a simple timeline based on key events
automatically drafting updates, summaries and follow-up actions based on your incident activity
